schema.description: A unique ID generated by the client.
Office site ID. This parameter has the same meaning as `OfficeSiteId`. Stop using `DirectoryId`. Use `OfficeSiteId` instead. You can specify only one of `DirectoryId` or `OfficeSiteId`, not both.

Session ID for the login request.

Do not specify this parameter if you have not bound a virtual MFA device or enabled client-based secondary authentication. Specify this parameter after the ADPassword step if you have bound a virtual MFA device or enabled client-based secondary authentication. You can get this value from the response to the GetLoginToken request when CurrentStage is ADPassword.

Current authentication stage. Valid values:

1. `ADPassword`: Verify user credentials. Specify this value when using convenience account or Active Directory (AD) account credentials.

2. `MFABind`: Bind a virtual MFA device.

3. `MFAVerify`: Verify the security code generated by the virtual MFA device.

4. `TokenVerify`: Client-based secondary authentication.

5. `ChangePassword`: Change the user password.

6. `KeepAliveVerify`: Exchange a valid KeepAliveToken for a LoginToken.

7. `PhoneVerifyTenantSelect`: Select an enterprise ID to log in when using phone number authentication.

8. `VerifyForRisk`: Identity verification after risk detection.
Username for a convenience account or an AD domain account. Required when `CurrentStage` is `ADPassword`.
Password for a convenience account or an AD domain account. Required when `CurrentStage` is `ADPassword`.
Security code generated by a virtual MFA device. Required when `CurrentStage` is `MFAVerify`.

Verification code sent to the end user's mailbox. This occurs when client-based secondary authentication is enabled in the WUYING Workspace Enterprise Edition console and a risk is detected during login. Required when `CurrentStage` is `TokenVerify`.
Device fingerprint. This parameter is deprecated.
Whether to keep the session active.

Token used to maintain an active session. The API returns this token after successful login if the user enables the Keep Alive option. During the validity period of the KeepAliveToken, call GetLoginToken with CurrentStage set to KeepAliveVerify to exchange it for a LoginToken. Required when CurrentStage is KeepAliveVerify.
Unique client identifier. If you use the WUYING client, find this value in the About dialog box on the login screen.

Image URL.

> This parameter is deprecated.

Encrypted device fingerprint.

> This parameter is deprecated.
SSO login cookies. Used for single sign-on within applications.
ID of the identity provider. Get this value by calling [FindIdpListByLoginIdentifier](~~FindIdpListByLoginIdentifier~~).

Mobile phone number. Used for phone number authentication.

> This feature is not supported for Alibaba Cloud International Website accounts.

Phone verification code. Used for phone number authentication.

> This feature is not supported for Alibaba Cloud International Website accounts.
Site where the tenant is located.

Email.description:
User email address. Returned with the LoginToken after login.

- If the user uses a convenience account, this is the email address specified when creating the account.

- If the user uses an AD domain account, this is in the format: username\@AD domain name.

Secret.description:
Secret key used when binding a virtual MFA device. Used in the `MFABind` stage.

> For details about authentication stages, see the description of the `CurrentStage` request parameter.

EndUserId.description: Convenience account username or AD username.

NextStage.description:
Expected next authentication stage. For example, if an administrator enables MFA in the WUYING Workspace Enterprise Edition console, the NextStage parameter returns `MFAVerify` after successful ADPassword authentication. This indicates that MFA verification is required.

> For details about authentication stages, see the description of the `CurrentStage` request parameter.

QrCodePng.description:
QR code for binding a virtual MFA device. Base64-encoded. Can be empty. Used in the `MFABind` stage.

> For details about authentication stages, see the description of the `CurrentStage` request parameter.

Label.description: Convenience account attribute. Empty for AD domain accounts.

SessionId.description: Session ID. Returned only on the first call to GetLoginToken in a session. Include this value in subsequent calls for multi-step authentication.

Phone.description: Mobile phone number for a convenience account. Empty for AD domain accounts.

TenantId.description: Alibaba Cloud account ID. Used for hardware terminal identification.

KeepAliveToken.description: Token used to maintain an active session. The API returns this token after successful login if the user enables the Keep Alive option. Returns empty if the Keep Alive option is disabled.

VpcRegionId.description: VPC region ID. Used for VPC-based login.

AccountType.description: Account type. Valid values: convenience account or AD domain account.

TenantInfos.description: Enterprise ID information. When logging in with a phone number, a single phone number may be associated with multiple enterprise IDs. In this case, set CurrentStage to PhoneVerifyTenantSelect to select one enterprise ID for login.

TenantAlias.description: Name of the enterprise identifier used for login.

OfficeSites.description: Office site information for the AD domain after AD authentication.

items.description: Office site ID for the AD domain after AD authentication.

IdpId.description: ID of the identity source configuration for the user.

RiskVerifyInfo.description: Information related to risk detection during login. If a risk is detected, verify your identity using the returned email address or phone number. Call the `SendVerifyCode` API with the returned phone number or email address to send a verification code. Then call the `GetLoginToken` API with `CurrentStage` set to `VerifyForRisk` to complete verification.

Email.description: Email address used for identity verification.

Locked.description: Indicates whether the user is locked.

Phone.description: Phone number used for identity verification.

MfaTypeList.description: List of MFA verification types available when MFA verification is triggered.

Stage.description: Value for the CurrentStage parameter after selecting an MFA type.
